title: Eurocopter Tiger UHT (pilot)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The Tiger UHT is the German version of the Tiger, built mainly to fight tanks. Instead of the French gun turret it carries gun pods under the stub wings, and its main sight sits on top of the rotor mast, so the helicopter can look over trees while staying hidden. The pilot's controls and panels are taken as those of the Tiger HAP/HAD, so this guide builds on that guide.
